days.title: Imperial Heritage and Peaks
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Kulpenberg
stops.detail: Its highest elevation is the Kulpenberg, on which a television tower has stood since the 1960s.

stops.name: Reichsburg Kyffhausen
stops.detail: On a mountain spur in the northeast of the Kyffhäuser Mountains are the ruins of the Reichsburg Kyffhausen, which were complemented at the end of the 19th century by the Kyffhäuser Monument in honor of Emperor Wilhelm I.

stops.name: Burgbrunnen
stops.detail: Parts of the ruins of the Upper and Lower Castle, however, were preserved, and the 176 m deep castle well was also restored.

days.title: Caves and Historical Monuments
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Barbarossahöhle
stops.detail: Other signal towers of trigonometric points in the Kyffhäuser were located on the Saukopf (between Tilleda and Udersleben), on the Schlachtberg next to the Peasants' War monument north of Bad Frankenhausen, next to the Falkenburg above (north) of the Barbarossa Cave (Rottleben), and on the Stöckey between Badra and the Numburg.

stops.name: Panoramamuseum Bad Frankenhausen
stops.detail: Schlachtberg (271.0 m), north of Bad Frankenhausen with the Peasants' War Panorama (Panorama Museum Bad Frankenhausen), with the Thomas Müntzer Memorial and with the nearby Hausmannsturm (Frankenburg), approx. 800 m to the south.

stops.name: Königspfalz Tilleda
stops.detail: Pfingstberg (approx. 196 m), on the southern edge of Tilleda with the Tilleda Royal Palace and the Schusterhöhle cave located at the palace.
